nom: PEACH & LILY Glass Skin Refining Serum

segments.oily: One reviewer with acne-prone, oily skin says the serum does not cause breakouts and has improved texture and scarring.
segments.dry: Several reviewers with dry skin report it prevents tightness and itching and leaves skin smooth and hydrated, though one dry-skin reviewer found it slightly drying with no added moisture.
segments.combination: A reviewer with combination, freckled, dull/red-prone skin reports brighter, more even tone, smaller pores, and softened fine lines.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive, reactive, rosacea, or eczema-prone skin mostly report calming, non-irritating hydration, but one rosacea reviewer reports it triggered pimples the next day.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 30s-70s report smoother texture, firmness, reduced fine lines, and an anti-aging effect with regular use.

concerns.aging: Reviewers report fewer visible fine lines, firmer-looking skin, and a younger-looking glow with continued use; one mature reviewer's daughter/mother also noticed reduced wrinkle visibility.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe strong hydration, plumping, and relief from tightness and dryness; a couple of reviewers report it did not add moisture and felt drying.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report reduced redness, splotchiness, and calmer, more even-toned skin, including one who said longstanding redness cleared up almost overnight.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with reactive or eczema-prone skin report soothing, non-irritating use with no flare-ups, though one rosacea reviewer reports a reactive breakout.
concerns.spots: Reviewers mention improvement in hyperpigmentation, discoloration, and acne scars/marks with continued use.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone reviewers report no new breakouts and some clearing of acne, but one reviewer with rosacea reports new pimples appearing after use.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with oily, acne-prone skin reports the serum does not cause breakouts or excess oil; no other oiliness-specific complaints are mentioned.

aspects.libelle: Bottle underfilled or runs out fast
No added moisture for some users

extraits.texte: I don't get it. This is fairly expensive, yet doesn't do anything special. It comes in a lightweight plastic bottle, which honestly surprised me considering the price. It's a little drying, doesn't feel like it adds any moisture. I just don't get it. I actually like the niacinimide serum from The Ordinary much, much better. It's less expensive, comes in a glass bottle, and leaves my skin softer with more glow. I feel like I seriously wasted my money :(
